title: Verify: store focus drives scene highlight unit tests
summary: Phaser-mocked BootScene tests for focus sync and keyboard store write
description: Mock phaser, content and buildScene as in bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts. Fakes expose focus, blur, sync, destroy, onInteract, handleKey, isFocused, spec. Update existing bootScene* test fakes that lack focus and blur if they now fail.

steps.action: Copy the vi.mock blocks and BootScene create setup from bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts. Build two fakes (bookshelf, bed) with focus: vi.fn(), blur: vi.fn(), isFocused false. Test 1: useGameStore.setState({ focusedObjectId: 'bed' }) then assert bed.focus called once and bookshelf.focus not called. Test 2: set bed.isFocused true, setState({ focusedObjectId: null }), assert bed.blur called. Test 3: press Tab via the registered keydown handler with moveFocus mocked and bookshelf.isFocused true, assert useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId equals 'bookshelf' and phaserToReact.emit called with focusChange.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusSync.test.ts tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts
steps.expected: New tests pass and the keyboard suite stays green.
